g.text: i was sitting here thinking to myself "self, you sexy amazing super-smart awesome world-saving badass,"
I TOTALLY SPACE CADET'D AND FORGOT TO FOLLOW UP ABOUT DUVIRI
I'M SUCH A SPACE CADET I REALIZED I'VE NEVER REALLY ASKED YOU ANYTHING ABOUT DUVIRI
after all, i've dumped all the trauma bullshit about my past on your ass
i mean, i told you about the reactor and entrati and everything
i mean don't get me wrong it's a sweet ass and all :3
but i realized i don't know anything about what got YOU here not really not anything past 'lol alternate dimension loopy powers'
i know i told you how i was an intern at the O.R.O and everything
i know i haven't really told you anything about how i got here or my past or whatever
As different as our pasts were, I feel like we actually have a lot in common.
Can you narrow it down? I have a lot of history.
It's not something I like talking about. [End.]
I turned to stories and fiction as a way to deal with my trauma.
I was thrown into things I had no business being a part of, and had to learn to cope.
When I was on board the Zariman, we... sort of ran into the Void. The Man in the Wall came.
Duviri was... built entirely out of stories that the Void plucked out of my head. Like a dream turned into a nightmare.
My whole life has been me clinging to the back end of a screaming train because of the decisions of others.
He - *it* - decided it'd be interesting to see what happened if the parents turned on their children.
looping over and over and over again like a level in a video game with a cheat code for endless lives?!
A video game where the pain and the death and the agony was *real* and the suffering was *mine.*
I just fight as hard as I can to keep my moral compass and my head above water. One day at a time.
Then it gifted the children with Void powers and...
I'm sure you're going to tell me it sounds awesome.
It was just like that, actually.
when you think "real life video game" at first it sounds awesome, right? and then you think... wait...
First the Zariman. Then Duviri. Then Ballas and the New War. Now this...
no actually i wasn't but thanks for putting words in my mouth because video game characters don't feel real pain
will i only have NPCs to talk to? will i be truly alone? will i feel every time i lose a level...?
yeah when i.. have nightmares about all the people i've killed, they...
like bruno and vito don't ACTUALLY die and don't ACTUALLY come back to life and have to do it again...
yeah except when I accidentally keep throwing the Super Bruno Brothers down a hole THEY DON'T FEEL PAIN
that sounds like hell... like literal hell
aren't the faces of my parents staring back at me... that's... that's a whole lot...
that's horrifying and i'm so, so sorry... how could you even cope?
now i feel like a shitheel for bitching about my problems
A lot like you, at first, actually. Nightmares. Too much emotion.
but... yeah... guess we do have something in common...
hey uh next time i have one of these nightmares mind if i come yell PULL IT INTO HUG HARBOR
i feel like we'll both need one
what you afraid of cooties? whatever
